translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Mateo

content: An jalpith cau c’al an ajib tin cuenta an tomquintalab
A Jesús in olchiye an inicchic i jalpith cau antse’. In ucha’chic:
―Nan ne’ets tu olchiyechic jant’ini’ tin t’ajal a Dios ti Ts’ale. Jun i ts’ale ne’ets quin t’ajchi in cuitolil an tomquintalab ajib.
In aba’its i olchixchic quin caniychic patal axi bijithits ca chich, ani tocat yab in le’chic ca chich.
Tam in abaye ca uchanchat: Ts’ejcathits an c’apnel. Tsemthachits an c’apnel toro ani an t’u’uthmethach co’nel. Cum lej t’ojojothits tihua’, ca lej luba’ quit c’aletschic c’al an tomquintalabcua’.
Ani ma lejatits yab in t’ajat t’aja’chic ti cuenta ca utey axi lej bijithits. Jun c’alets ti lonim c’al in tsabalil, ani jun c’alets ti nujul.
Ani talchic axi q’ue’at ma tocat in yac’ua’ an olchixchic quin lej alhua’ cuatha’, ma in tsemtha’.
Tam lej tsacuyits an ts’ale, ma in aba’ i soldado quin tsemtha’chic axi tsemthomats c’al an olchix ani quin tala’ chica’ am bichou.
Taley talbel an ts’ale in ucha’ in t’ojnalilchic: Lej jum putat t’ojojothits an ajib, ani axi lej bijithits ca chich yabats ca pithan an q’uij ca chich.
Jaxtam quit c’alechic ca caniy ca chich c’al an tomquintalab ajib patal axi ca tamuq’ui ti alte’ belchic, in ulu.
Ani c’alechic xe’ets in canalchic patal jahuaquitsq’ui tam inic max alhua’ ani max yab alhua’. In ne’thachicalchic c’al an tomquintalab ajib. Ani taley ma jilc’on t’uchichithits an ata.
Tam otsitsits an ts’ale quin tsu’u axi chi’thachitschic, ani taja’ in tsu’u jun i inic axi yab toltomith c’al in cuenta an tomquintalab.
Ani uchan c’al an ts’ale: ¿Ja’ub, jant’ini’ tit otsenenequits teje’ ani yab it toltomith c’al an toltom ax in cuenta an tomquintalab? Ani yab jant’o in toc’tsiy nixe’ xi inic.

Tam an ts’ale in ucha’chic in t’ojnalilchic c’al in cuenta an ajib: Ca huic’chi in acan ani in c’ubac nixe’ xi inic ani ca jolou eleb ti al an yic’uax. Tats ca uq’uin ani ca huech’ech’lats in camab c’al an yajchictalab.
In uluye a Jesús: Hua’ats yan i inicchic u caniyab c’al a Dios ca otsits c’al jaja’, ani hue’ expith axi tacuthits ja’its ax u otsel.
An jalbixtalab tumin c’al an gobierno
Taley an fariseochic in ts’ejca’ an cau jant’ini’ ti quin t’ajchi a Jesús abal max quin ulu i q’uibts’oth cau c’al ca ejtohuat ca jolbiyat.

In aba’chic talchic in at fariseo ani jaye talchic axi ts’at’at c’al a Herodes quin tauna’ a Jesús. Ulitschic ani in ucha’: ―Exobchix, i tso’ob abal jahua’ tata’ ca ulu pel i lej chubaxtalab. Expith a olnanchal in tequeth belil a Dios. Yab a t’ajal ti cuenta jahua’its it uxnal c’al an inic, ani yab it poc’oth tsu’tom c’al an inicchic.
Tucu ucha’ max i cua’al i uchbil o max yab i cua’al qui jalbiy an jalbixtalab tumin c’al an ts’ale oc’lec romano.
Cum a Jesús in exla’its abal pel i c’ambix cau, jaxtam in toc’tsiychic antse’: ―Tata’ ojni’chic it c’ambix. ¿Jale’ a le’ tiquin macla’?
Qui met’a’ jun i tumin ax a jalbixnal. Tam pithanits.
Tam in met’a’ ani in conoy: ―¿Jita’ axe’ in hual ani jita’ axe’ im bij axi thuchath teje’ al an tumin?

Toc’tsin jaja’chic: ―Pel in hual ani pel im bij an ts’ale oc’lec. Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Ca pitha’ an ts’ale oc’lec jahua’ pel a uchbil ca pitha’, ani ca pitha’ a Dios jahua’ pel a uchbil ca pitha’ jaye.
Tam tin ats’a’chic antsana’ an fariseo an cau, tocat in lej jic’pal. Tam tixc’anchic c’al a Jesús, ani ta c’alets.
Conoyab a Jesús tin cuenta abal ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic
Nixe’ xa q’uicha chich jaye i saduceochic c’al a Jesús. Cum yab im belalchic abal max ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic, jaxtam uchan a Jesús c’al jaja’chic:

―Exobchix, a Moisés in thucha’ abal max ca tsemets jun i tomquith inic ani yab in co’oyamal i tsacam c’al in q’uimathil, ca tomquin in ebchal an tsemelom c’al an tsemchith uxum. Lequitsq’ui max quin co’oy i tsacam tam.
Hua’atsac c’al huahua’ buc i ebchalab. Tomquin an oc’ox, ani tsemets yab in co’oyamal i tsacam. Taley tomquin in tsabchil ebchal an tsemelom c’al an tsemchith uxum.
Tsemets jaja’ jaye. Ma tim patal nixe’ xi buc i ebchalab tomquinenec c’al nixe’ xi uxum juncats.
Taley tsemets jaye an uxum.
¿Cum tomquinenec an uxum c’al axi buc i ebchalab teje’ tsabal, c’al jahua’ ti ne’ets ca c’uajiy ti tomiclab tam ca ejtha’ an tsemelomchic?
A Jesús in toc’tsiychic: ―Tata’chic ojni’ lej q’uibts’othits a tsalap tin cuenta an tsemelomchic, cum yab a exlal an T’ocat Thuchlab ani yab a exlanchal in tsap a Dios.
Tam ca ejtha an tsemelomchic in ey an inic ani in ey an uxum yabats ne’ets ca tomquin. Ne’ets ca c’uajiychic ejtil an ángelchic axi ti eb yab u tomquinal.
Tin cuenta abal u ejthab an tsemelomchic, auxe’ max yab a ajiyamalchic jahua’ in ulu a Dios ani jahua’ thuchathits. In ulu antse’:

Nana’its pel tin Diosil a Abraham ani tin Diosil a Isaac ani tin Diosil a Jacob, in ulu. Cum pel in Diosil nixe’ xi ox i inic axi tsemenec teje’ tsabal, jaxtam i exlalits abal bel c’uajatchic ejate tin tamet a Dios.
Ani lej jic’panchab in exobchixtal a Jesús c’al an inicchic taja’.
An uchbixtalab axi más huinat exbath
Taley tam ti an fariseochic in ats’a’ abal atanits an saduceochic yab in ejtou quin toc’tsiy a Jesús, tamna’ tamcun jaja’chic jaye.
Ani jun axi pel i exobchix c’al an ts’ejcath cau in le’ quin tacchiquiy a Jesús. Jaxtam chich ani in conoy:
―¿Exobchix, jahua’ hualam an uchbixtalab axi más lej huinat exbath ti al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés?
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Ca lej jum putat c’anitha’ a Pay’lom Diosil c’al patal a ichich, ani c’al patal a ejattal, ani c’al patal a tsalapcua’.
Nan tu uchalchic abal ja’its an uchbixtalab axi más lej huinat exbath.
Huinat exbath jaye an uchbixtalab axi thuchath c’al a Moisés antse’: Ca c’anitha’ patal a at inic jant’ini’ ta c’anithal ta ba’cua’.
C’al axe’ xi tsab i uchbixtalab c’uajat mac’uchithits tim patal an uchbixtalab ti al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés, ani jaye tim patal in exobchixtal am biyal caulomechic c’al a Dios.
In ey a Cristo
C’uajate tamcuth an fariseochic.
Ani conoyabchic c’al a Jesús: ―¿Jant’o ta tsalpanchalchic in ey a Cristo? ¿C’al jita’ c’al tu tsacamlab? Toc’tsinchic: ―Pel in tsacamil a David.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Yab ja cum a David c’uajchith c’al an Espíritu Santo im bijiy a Cristo tin Ajatic. In ulu antse’:
A Dios in ucha’ u Ajatic:

content.text: Teje’ quit buxcan tu huinab c’ubac, ma nan tu pitha’its ta c’ubac a tomolnaxilchic abal ca tala’ ata’.

content: Cum antsana’ a David im bijiy a Cristo tin Ajatic, jaxtam i tso’obits abal yab pel in tsacamil a David.
C’al nixe’ xi cau ni jita’ yab in ejtou quin toc’tsiy a Jesús. Ani ni jita’ taja’ yab in inicnal tim ba’ abal quin conomichiquiye a Jesús c’al más i cau.
